Synopsys (SNPS) shares have slipped 8.4% over the past month, outpacing the 3.3% dip in the S&P 500, and now sit 12.6% below their highest close of the past year. For current investors, the bigger worry is what a real market sell-off could do from here. So how hard has Synopsys been hit in past market shocks , and how long did it take to get back?

How Far Synopsys Stock Fell In Past Market Shocks

The stock suffered its deepest drop during the 2008-2009 financial crisis, losing 45% compared with a 53% decline for the S&P 500. Across all market shocks since 2007, Synopsys shares fell 17.1% on average, slightly exceeding the 15.8% drop in the broader index.

In some shocks the stock fell harder than the market. In the 2024 yen trade unwind, Synopsys fell 21% while the S&P 500 lost 7.8%. In the 2025 tariff shock, the most recent, it fell 24%, against 19% for the index.

Synopsys Is Bigger Now, And Owes Far More

Revenue at Synopsys rose 42.4% from a year earlier to $2.48 billion in fiscal Q3 2026, the quarter ended July 31. On the August 26 call, management said about $711 million of that total came from Ansys, marking one year into the combination.

Synopsys retains a smaller share of its sales as operating profit than it did two years ago. The company posted an operating margin of 11.0% over the twelve months to July 2026, down from 24.6% in the twelve months to July 2024. In the latest quarter, the margin improved to 14.5% from 9.5% a year earlier.

Debt levels climbed to $10.8 billion at the end of July 2026, up from $0.67 billion two years earlier. Management said the company repaid its term loans earlier than planned. Debt was $15.1 billion a year earlier, so it has come down since then. Synopsys debt now equals 12.1% of the company’s market value, compared with 19.4% for the S&P 500.

On the August 26 call, management said new chip designs from customers outside AI had been slowing and only stopped declining in the last two quarters, while design starts among AI customers kept speeding up.

Synopsys also raised its expected restructuring charges for fiscal 2026 as it speeds up the cost savings it committed to. Management expects total GAAP costs and expenses of $8.667 billion to $8.742 billion for the year. It expects revenue of $9.69 billion to $9.74 billion.

Backlog stood at $10.9 billion at the end of fiscal Q3 2026, modestly down from the quarter before. Management attributed this dip to the sale of its processor IP solutions business. Backlog is the figure to watch when Synopsys reports fiscal Q4 2026 results, expected in December 2026.

Synopsys (SNPS) 股价在过去一个月下跌了 8.4%，超过了标准普尔 500 指数 3.3% 的跌幅，目前比去年最高收盘价低了 12.6%。对于当前的投资者来说，更大的担忧是真正的市场抛售会带来什么后果。那么新思科技在过去的市场冲击中受到的打击有多大，花了多长时间才恢复过来？

Synopsys 股票在过去的市场冲击中下跌了多少

该股在 2008-2009 年金融危机期间遭遇了最严重的跌幅，下跌了 45%，而标准普尔 500 指数则下跌了 53%。在 2007 年以来的所有市场冲击中，新思科技股价平均下跌 17.1%，略高于大盘指数 15.8% 的跌幅。

在某些冲击中，股票的跌幅比大盘还要大。在 2024 年日元交易中，Synopsys 下跌 21%，而标准普尔 500 指数下跌 7.8%。在最近的 2025 年关税冲击中，该指数下降了 24%，而该指数下降了 19%。

新思科技 (Synopsys) 现在规模更大，但欠下的债也更多

截至 7 月 31 日的季度，Synopsys 的 2026 财年第三季度收入同比增长 42.4% 至 24.8 亿美元。在 8 月 26 日的电话会议上，管理层表示，其中约 7.11 亿美元来自 Ansys，标志着合并已满一年。

新思科技作为营业利润保留的销售额份额比两年前要小。该公司截至 2026 年 7 月的 12 个月的营业利润率为 11.0%，低于截至 2024 年 7 月的 12 个月的 24.6%。在最近一个季度，利润率从去年同期的 9.5% 提高至 14.5%。

截至 2026 年 7 月底，债务水平从两年前的 6.7 亿美元攀升至 108 亿美元。管理层表示，该公司比计划提前偿还了定期贷款。一年前的债务为 151 亿美元，自那以来债务有所下降。 Synopsys 债务目前相当于公司市值的 12.1%，而标准普尔 500 指数的债务为 19.4%。

在 8 月 26 日的电话会议上，管理层表示，人工智能以外客户的新芯片设计一直在放缓，直到过去两个季度才停止下降，而人工智能客户的设计启动速度不断加快。

Synopsys 还提高了 2026 财年的预期重组费用，以加速其承诺的成本节约。管理层预计今年 GAAP 成本和支出总额为 86.67 亿美元至 87.42 亿美元。预计营收为 96.9 亿美元至 97.4 亿美元。

截至 2026 年第三财季末，积压订单量为 109 亿美元，较上一季度略有下降。管理层将这种下滑归因于处理器IP解决方案业务的出售。新思科技 (Synopsys) 预计将于 2026 年 12 月发布 2026 年第四季度财报时，需要关注待办事项数量。
